verified_facts.text: Itz'ana is a beachfront and marina resort in Placencia, Belize.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover Itz’ana Resort & Residences, a luxury beachfront and marina resort in Placencia, Belize.

verified_facts.text: The resort's address is Mile 20 Placencia Road, Placencia, Stann Creek District, Belize.
verified_facts.excerpt: Mile 20 Placencia Road, Placencia, Stann Creek District, Belize

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a white-sand beach on the Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sink into the soft sand of a pristine white-sand beach.

verified_facts.text: The beach villas have multiple bedrooms, full kitchens, decks, plunge pools and Caribbean views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Live and entertain luxuriously in chic, multi-bedroom villas with kitchens, decks, plunge pools, and idyllic Caribbean views.

verified_facts.text: Villa and penthouse interiors are designed by Samuel Amoia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interior design by Samuel Amoia

verified_facts.text: The One Bedroom Beachfront Villa has an outdoor bathtub and rainforest shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Outdoor bathtub and rainforest shower

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Beach Villa has a plunge pool on its beachfront deck and an atrium garden with an indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Relax in the plunge pool on your beachfront deck or escape to the atrium garden with an indoor pool.

verified_facts.text: The penthouses sit above the resort with expansive terraces, private plunge pools and views across the resort and Caribbean Sea.
verified_facts.excerpt: our two- and three-bedroom penthouses bring together generous indoor and outdoor living, expansive terraces, private plunge pools, and views across the resort and Caribbean Sea

verified_facts.text: Marina Villas each have a private plunge pool, and the One-Bedroom Marina Villa has a waterfront deck and dedicated boat dock.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a private plunge pool, waterfront deck, and dedicated boat dock

verified_facts.text: The full-service marina has a watersports activity center, refueling station and supplies store.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our full - service marina features a watersports activity center, refueling station, and supplies store.

verified_facts.text: The marina is on the calm lagoon waters of Placencia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Itz’ana Marina is located along the calm lagoon waters of Placencia, Belize

verified_facts.text: Coral Caye is the resort's private island off the coast of Placencia.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape to Coral Caye, Itz’ana’s private island off the coast of Placencia.

verified_facts.text: Coral Caye is a two-acre private island with ocean-view cottages, a thatched dining pavilion and a dedicated island team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Coral Caye is a serene two-acre private island escape off the coast of Belize, offering barefoot comfort, ocean-view cottages, a thatched dining pavilion, and a dedicated island team.

verified_facts.text: Coral Caye is off-grid and solar-powered.
verified_facts.excerpt: Off-grid and solar-powered, it is ideal for families or adults seeking privacy, peace, and total disconnection.

verified_facts.text: Coral Caye is available for day trips, private island picnics, overnight stays and curated experiences.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available for day trips, private island picnics, overnight stays, and curated experiences

verified_facts.text: Guided yoga, breathwork and movement sessions take place along the Caribbean shoreline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reconnect body and mind with guided yoga, breathwork, and movement sessions set directly along the Caribbean shoreline.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments can be arranged in the guest's suite or villa.
verified_facts.excerpt: unwind with a personalized spa treatment in the comfort of your suite or villa

verified_facts.text: Private meditation and sound healing sessions are available on request.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reconnect with yourself through private meditation and sound healing sessions

verified_facts.text: Limilia Restaurant serves seasonal, seafood-forward cuisine using produce from the resort's organic farm and fish line-caught by its own fisherman.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal, seafood-forward cuisine highlights locally sourced ingredients, including vegetables and herbs from our organic farm and fresh fish line-caught by our own fisherman.

verified_facts.excerpt: Through rum and beer tastings, chocolate workshops, Garifuna cooking, hair braiding, and drumming lessons
